overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state compression for endgame snapshots, optimizing Monte Carlo convergence checks, and locking in colonist psychological state transitions with zero-heap overhead. This batch closes all remaining gaps in the 5,500-tick campaign model.

tasks.title: Deterministic Bit-Packed State Snapshotter
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a constexpr-friendly, zero-heap state snapshotter using std::bit_cast and manual bit-packing. Structure: struct Snapshot { uint64_t tick; uint32_t flags; uint16_t colonist_ids[4]; }. Use static_assert for size checks. No dynamic allocation. Serialize to fixed-size byte array via memcpy. Deserialize via bitwise shifts. Ensure endianness consistency with std::endian::native. All operations must be noexcept. Include unit tests for round-trip fidelity on 16,500 logged footsteps.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Snapshot size <= 32 bytes. 2. Round-trip serialization/deserialization is bit-exact. 3. Zero heap allocations during snapshot creation. 4. Compilation passes with -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster save/load times and smaller save files, improving responsiveness in long campaigns.

tasks.title: Monte Carlo Convergence Validator
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a fixed-iteration Monte Carlo validator for survival rates. Use a static array of 1024 samples. Compute mean and variance using Kahan summation for numerical stability. Define a convergence threshold epsilon = 1e-6. If variance < epsilon, mark as converged. Return a struct { bool converged; float mean; float variance; }. No dynamic memory. Use std::array. Ensure deterministic ordering of samples. Validate against the known 100% survival rate baseline.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Convergence detected within 1024 iterations for 100% survival cases. 2. Numerical stability verified via Kahan summation. 3. No heap allocations. 4. Deterministic output for identical seeds.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Provides immediate, reliable feedback on simulation stability without long wait times.

tasks.title: Colonist Psychological State Lattice
tasks.architectural_spec: Define a finite state machine for colonist psychology using enum class and constexpr transitions. States: IDLE, WORKING, STRESSED, ASCENDED. Transitions are stored in a static constexpr array of pairs. Implement a step function that takes current state and event ID, returns next state. No heap. Use std::array for transition table. Ensure all states are reachable from IDLE. Add a debug string converter for each state. Validate against the 5,500-tick log.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. All 4 states are reachable. 2. No undefined transitions. 3. Zero heap allocations. 4. Debug strings match expected values.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Clearer, more predictable colonist behavior and easier debugging of AI logic.
